svg.aria-label: Three grids, each with seven receivers as rows and time steps as columns, for one channel. In the quiet run every cell is a slightly different light grey. In the staged run from the same seed, every cell is the same as in the quiet run except a block covering three receivers for part of the hour, which is dark. The third grid shows the difference: blank everywhere except that block, which is the answer key.
svg.text: what the generator records as the answer key
every other cell is identical to (a)
One channel shown; shades are illustrative. Panel (c) is (b) minus (a).
